info.title: AeroRoster local development API
info.description: Unauthenticated local development only. API host must be localhost, 127.0.0.1 or IPv6 loopback; Origin, when present, must match scheme, host and port. Duplicate JSON properties are rejected. Do not publicly deploy as a production-ready service. All scheduling limits are illustrative academic settings. Eligibility never reserves a slot. Phase 2.6 frozen baseline: mutable resources expose version; existing-record changes require X-Expected-Version: id:version from the original edit snapshot (428 missing, 409 STALE_VERSION changed).
